newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices steady on low consumer demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices steady on low consumer demand.

text.p: Indian sugar prices held steady on Friday though consumer demand was low, dealers said. consumer
They said limited arrivals kept market quiet.
Volumes were very low as transport was disrupted during a strike called by trade unions to mourn the death of a prominent trade union leader who was murdered on Thursday.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,270/1,280 rupees per quintal while M-30 was steady at 1,300/1,370 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery was quoted steady at 1,200/1,220 rupees per quintal.
